title: custodian job file v1
description: A job folder's own file: every key optional.

id.description: The job's id, given when it starts.

kind.description: specs (the folder's spec files, the default) or a job template's kind (triage).

origin.description: For an imported job: the digest of the bundle it came from.

count.description: Count the job's routes at open, after each step that changes code, and at close.

routes.description: A route counted (crate:<name>, decl:<name>, *); the template's count_route, else the workspace. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
